description: Syntax highlighting, snippets and offline live previews for Fumen chord charts.
config.print.chromePath: Optional absolute path to the Google Chrome executable. Leave empty to detect a standard installation. Used only for local printing; workspace settings cannot override this path.
config.diagnostics.enabled: Check setting values and unclosed delimiters. Chord names and musical content are not validated.
config.diagnostics.delay: Delay in milliseconds after typing stops before updating diagnostics.
